Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000335" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhooks service relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down, the webhooks service is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down, the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000055": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000589" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-15, anything Boreal-related should be paged to Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000394": As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000488": As of 2025-06-11, the notifier went to the Dune team, which the Boreal team owned until 2025-06-11; the Cinder team never owned the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000583": As of 2025-08-15, Marcus has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000367": On 2025-05-07, the Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000011": As of 2025-01-07, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000557": As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team for the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000541": As of 2025-07-24, the Dune team sits on the fourth floor.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000547": On 2025-07-30, Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000480": As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler lives with the Dune team, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000338" [decision]: As of 2025-04-21, the Dune team adopted a monthly game day.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000279": As of 2025-03-20, the reporting service is owned by the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000318": As of 2025-04-07, the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000097": As of 2025-01-13, the first on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
Existing entity names: the bus, webhook dispatcher, notifier, Boreal team, Marcus, Cinder, Dune team, Lena, authentication gateway, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, ledger service, Ember team, job scheduler, reporting service, Farah

[2025-08-15] standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2: Team Boreal still owns the bus, in case anyone asks.
